Photo 2: a shorter matching black velvet channel-tufted sofa with gold legs, sized for two, in a different spot by a dark door.

No visible tears, stains or sagging at this resolution, but black velvet hides marks and the watermark covers the seat area.
No label, brand or maker mark visible in any photo.
Back, underside and cushion close-ups are not shown.
